top_signals.title: Delta Delays Nonstop Service to Saudi Arabia Amid Conflict
top_signals.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc. said it plans to delay the launch of its nonstop service between Atlanta and Saudi Arabia until next year due to drone and cruise missile attacks detected by the country on Monday.

top_signals.title: The Last Mile of Pentagon Reform Runs Through the Brigade
top_signals.summary:
A kill chain measured in seconds cannot depend on processes measured in weeks or months. The Pentagon recognizes that drone proliferation and AI-enabled lethal targeting are reducing decision cycles and increasing the premium on speed.
